decisions.reason: A core building-block sensor that fits the established modular system, in a growing firm with slack and in-house production, gives no shortfall signal that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and supports the firm's industrial and energy-management direction, so its results likely meet aspirations and it stays in the line.

A four-channel solid state relay is a low-cost addition to the established control portfolio, and the firm's expansion and stocked components give it the slack to carry this product while demand develops.

The server room monitoring kit is a bundle of existing modules with somewhat less certain demand, but it costs little to keep and the growing firm faces no performance pressure that would prompt dropping it.
